## Task Requirements
You are working on reconstructing the repository 'axi_uart_periph' from scratch. Do NOT import, vendor, wrap, or call the original external library you are re-implementing (directly or indirectly). Treat this as a fully standalone local implementation.

Hard requirement: ALL required abstractions and algorithms must be implemented end-to-end from zero. Even if the target library provides high-level objects (e.g., DataFrame/Series/Index), you must implement their core data structures, behaviors, and algorithms yourself.

No placeholders: do NOT leave stubs, TODOs, or partial implementations. Do NOT use `pass`, `...`, `raise NotImplementedError`, `raise Exception('not implemented')`, or any equivalent 'not supported' fallback for required APIs. Every specified API must be fully functional, testable, and produce correct outputs.

Implement uart_pkg shared typedefs, enums, and constants to establish stable package contract for downstream modules. This batch delivers all AXI-Lite CSR address definitions (REG_CTRL/STATUS/TX_DATA/RX_DATA/BAUD), control/status register field masks, FIFO parameters, parity enum, baud generator constants, and interrupt bit definitions. All subsequent RTL modules will import via 'import uart_pkg::*;' to avoid parameter duplication per HINT-012, making this the foundational build artifact that unblocks leaf module implementation.

unit_to_spec.package:uart_pkg: uart_pkg contract: export all shared typedefs, enums, and constants for AXI UART peripheral. Must include: (1) UART frame params (data width, stop bits), (2) parity_e enum for PARITY_NONE/EVEN/ODD, (3) FIFO depth/width/addr_width constants, (4) AXI-Lite CSR address map (REG_CTRL/STATUS/TX_DATA/RX_DATA/BAUD), (5) Control register field positions and masks (TX_EN, RX_EN, PARITY_EN, PARITY_TYPE, INT_EN), (6) Status register field positions and masks (TX_EMPTY/FULL, RX_EMPTY/FULL, RX_DATA_RDY, FRAMING_ERR, PARITY_ERR, INT_PENDING), (7) Interrupt status bits, (8) Baud generator constants (OVERSAMPLE_RATIO, BAUD_TICK_MAX), (9) FIFO threshold constants (HALF_FULL, ALMOST_FULL, ALMOST_EMPTY). All modules import via 'import uart_pkg::*;' to avoid parameter duplication per HINT-012.
